# bioconductor-methyanalysis

## Overview

Use the Bioconductor R package **methyAnalysis** for: The package also includes functions of estimating the methylation levels from Methy-Seq data.

## Installation

```r
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("methyAnalysis")
```
